hook.subline: Abroad ki baat se pehle socho.

items.title: Kharcha kitna hoga?
items.detail: Tuition ke saath rent, khaana, insurance aur travel bhi jodo. Poore saal ka budget banao.

items.title: Safety ka kya?
items.detail: City, campus aur accommodation ke baare mein seniors se baat karo. Real experience suno.

items.title: Paise kahan se aayenge?
items.detail: Savings, scholarship aur education loan. Teeno options pehle se samjho.

items.title: Padhai ke baad kya?
items.detail: Course ka career outcome aur us country ke post-study work rules pehle check karo.

youtube.title: Abroad padhna hai? Parents ye 4 sawaal zaroor poochenge
youtube.description:
Mummy Papa se abroad ki baat karne se pehle in 4 sawaalon ke jawab ready rakho: kharcha, safety, paise kahan se, aur padhai ke baad kya.

Plan dikhaoge toh baat aasaan hogi.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. Contact aap karoge, hum nahi.
